literal_meaning: ঘর-বার করা (household management or going in and out of the home)
figurative_meaning_bn: কারো আকুল প্রতীক্ষায় ক্রমাগত ঘরের বাইরে যাওয়া ও ভিতরে আসা
figurative_meaning_en: Repeatedly going in and out of the house in eager anticipation of someone
similar_in_english: Wearing out the carpet with worry
example_sentences_in_bangla: ছেলে রাত পর্যন্ত না ফেরায় মা ঘরবার করছে।
পরীক্ষার ফলাফলের অপেক্ষায় ছাত্রী সকাল থেকে ঘরবার করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The mother is pacing in and out of the house because her son hasn't returned until late at night.
The student has been anxiously going in and out of the house since morning, waiting for the exam results.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali family dynamics where waiting for loved ones is a common emotional expression.
